name: Fairfax County Public Library Teen Advisory Boards
note: Re-verified against the library's own teen volunteer page on 2026-09-08. The page confirms the boards exist and that students apply at their branch, but publishes no age, grade, hours or deadline.

offerings.summary: Teens join a branch Teen Advisory Board to take service learning further and build leadership skills; positions are arranged with staff at the local branch.

grades.raw: Teen Advisory Boards where you can take your service learning to the next level and develop leadership skills.

app.instructions: Ask staff at your nearest branch what positions they have available.

issues: The page describes the boards as teen opportunities but publishes no age or grade floor.

sources.title: Teen Volunteer Opportunities | Fairfax County Public Library
